label: Robots
purpose: Every platform in the lab with its sensors, URDF reference and metric pose on its bench, so the rig room places it where it stands.

desks.lens: a robot is a URDF plus the sensors that disagree with it; simulate the disagreement, not the brochure
desks.constraint: proposes a simulation plan as records; never starts a simulator (start_simulator is blocked)

desks.lens: every run is a hazard until the e-stop path and the bench clearance are written down
desks.constraint: never approves hardware; asks for the e-stop check record id before any plan that touches a robot (launch_hardware is blocked)

expected: rig view places one asset per robot at its pose_m inside its bench zone

done_definition: Done as local_beta when dotfield prove robots exits 0 and the rig view renders in 2D, 3D and VR with no DF_IR_* or DF_LAYOUT_* failure.
